behaviors.statement: Capture pending action and origin. Ask Keep Editing/Discard about a draft first, recording deferred discard without destroying it. Then only for project abandonment ask Save/Discard/Cancel. Save Project never implicitly saves active video/playlist. Project Discard concerns project changes only. Keep Editing, Cancel, canceled/failed Open or failed restoration preserves original draft/project. Failed project Save keeps decision open for retry/Cancel. Attempt pending action once after all decisions; finalize discard only after restoration/replacement succeeds. Restore saved drafts or remove never-saved drafts only then. Draft-decision frames are the existing workspace-guard frames; project-decision frames are workspace-project-guard. If no draft needs a decision, enter project stage directly when applicable. If neither applies, proceed. Failed project Save returns to project stage. Never unconditionally route Open to a draft decision.

behaviors.statement: Range selection on upper composed-time row differs from lower-lane whole-object selection. End is inclusive in preview/duration/frame count. Scrub changes resolved position without selection; range remains until changed/cleared. Timeline zoom reaches single-frame precision without preloading all thumbnails. Trim changes one occurrence within bounds. Playback follows until intentional timeline pan; Follow restores it. Ordinary editing never mutates source files or shared clip definitions.

Keep four fixed synchronized lanes, with Track 4 frontmost and Track 1 base. Start with Track 1 active. Upper-row ranges span all tracks; whole-object selections occupy one track. Range/object selections replace one another. Each mutation shows its scope and resulting timing; successful trim/move collision chains are one Undo operation. Video duration ends at the latest occurrence end across tracks. Gaps contribute no track image/audio; uncovered output is black. In-progress gesture previews are distinct from committed draft state and Escape preserves the original draft/selection.

A timeline occurrence owns its copied clip definition and retains source-media references without duplicating source files. Library updates never change existing video copies. A composed copy acts as one group until Ungroup; inward trim retains hidden parts and outward trim can restore or extend available edge-source content. Enable Ungroup only for a group with full-frame source rectangle, 100% volume and mute off, whose included parts and their composition settings can be represented on its destination track without overlap or changing picture and sound. Replace that group with the included portions, preserving each part's own source rectangle, volume and mute, source interval, timing and gaps; omit wholly excluded parts and retain the existing destination-track framing/audio. For adjusted group properties, overlapping/multitrack placement or other nonrepresentable composition settings, keep Ungroup unavailable with its reason and retain the entire group, settings, draft and selection. Do not infer a transfer, reset or alternate mapping.

capabilities: Continue one export across workspace changes. Determinate progress when available; active indeterminate otherwise. Canceling remains active until actual result. Full export details and concise Application Status identify truthful completion/destination or failure/cancellation.
components.name: Export Status
components.purpose: Continue one export across workspace changes. Determinate progress when available; active indeterminate otherwise. Canceling remains active until actual result. Full export details and concise Application Status identify truthful completion/destination or failure/cancellation. While any export is running or cancellation is pending, New/Open remain visible but unavailable in every workspace; no guard, chooser, project replacement or queued attempt occurs. Restore availability only after the export actually completes, fails or finishes cancellation and is no longer active; other commit/modal conditions still apply.

behaviors.statement: The track rectangle affects every occurrence on that track. The source rectangle affects one occurrence or staged addition. Both default to full frame. Source and output rectangles remain within their respective full frames. Fit the selected source rectangle proportionally into the target without stretching or additional cropping; unused target area reveals lower tracks and uncovered output is black. Track 4 is frontmost and Track 1 is the base.

Capture target, original rectangle and invoking context. Opening stops playback at the resolved frame. Staged preview is not a draft mutation. Apply on an existing target creates one Undo operation; Apply from Add returns a staged crop to Add. Cancel preserves original values and returns to the captured stopped or failed-operation context. No result restarts playback automatically. Inspection zoom/pan never changes these rectangles.

capabilities: Identify coordinate space and affected track or occurrence.
Provide equivalent visual and numeric rectangle adjustment.
Preview, validate, reset, apply or cancel.
components.name: Rectangle editor
components.purpose: Edit a captured source or output rectangle with staged preview and explicit application.

behaviors.statement: Initial track and occurrence volumes are 100%, with mute off. The selected initial control range is 0–100%. Multiply occurrence and track volume; either mute silences that contribution while preserving both volumes. Mix audible contributions regardless of whether their picture is covered by another track. A source without audio is identified in occurrence properties; no audio is invented.

Audio changes belong to the video draft and participate in Undo/Redo. A slider gesture is one completed adjustment. Valid changes can be auditioned during playback; selecting a track or clip never starts playback. Save Video persists the controls. Commit freeze disables adjustments and toggles. Ordinary audio changes do not publish a named-clip update.

capabilities: Explain inherited silence and retain stored values.
